dogecoin.text: Dogecoin’s path to $11 hinges on outpacing rivals like Bitcoin. Adoption by Tesla & growing demand could push it past $8 by 2028, but its unlimited supply poses risks—volatility ahead!

Dogecoin could soar to $11 if it dominates the crypto market, says analysts. With a current market cap of $37.5B, a 30x jump to match Tesla’s $1.15T valuation would drive DOGE to $7.82—$11 isn’t far off!
